Name: Lumisteria Glimmering Clumps and Nodes
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a redone version of my old-time favorite Lumisteria Clumps and Nodes, now glimmering of being freshly redone for Item Extensions.

This mod is balanced around providing a vanilla-like experience, with nice occasional surprises while exploring the mines and skull cavern. These drops may drop slightly more than vanilla ones but are usually rarer.
Do you enjoy spotting something unusual while going down and down? Making pause to discover what is this shiny node you see just a bit further? Break the routine and some cool looking rocks?

This is the experience this mod intend on providing.

The more you go down, the more different rocks you may see, with more chance to see unusual rocks overall. The difficulty of this mod is balanced around the idea that getting to level 100 of the skull cavern is difficult. If you're very skilled, or use honorable elevators to get deeper, you may find the balance slightly more powerful.

This mod includes some new clumps, nodes and small additions. If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url], there's a very rare chance to find most common polished gems here.

In the 1.1.0 update, discover new nodes, including some exclusives to the Volcano, and some that you'll find in the Quarry in the mountain, that you'll unlock with various conditions. You may even occasionally find new nodes that will provide you some bombs for even more excitement!

In the 1.2.0 update, find monster nodes, risky nodes that gives you reward but also... You guessed right! Spawn monsters nearby. Is this coal worth the risk? Well of course, you never have enough coal anyway. Configurable, enabled by default.

Downloads.Description: This mod adds clumps and nodes in the mine and skull cavern, providing vanilla gems, ores and even minerals if you can go deep enough. You may find occasional nodes in the Volcano and the Quarry in the mountain. Now with monster nodes, configurable.
